maya: heads-up — TidalWave private VPC deploy window next Tue 02:00–04:00 UTC. Planning canary then full switch. Who's owning smoke + rollback?

liam: I can own smoke tests + load sanity. What load harness should I use? Can do 1k rps for 5m, then steady 200 rps. :thumbsup:

sophia: I'll own rollback and feature-flag flip. I will prepare terraform rollback plan and a quick script to revert traffic.

archie: I will run network ACL and KMS prechecks. Need customer public IPs and expected CIDR list from account team.

maya: Copy — putting a quick checklist below, confirm you can complete these by T-30m.

maya: ```
# TidalWave private deploy checklist (canary -> ramp)
- preflight: verify tunnel, KMS access, DNS entries
- infra: apply terraform change in staging then prod canary
- deploy: start canary (10% traffic) for 10m
- smoke: run health + sample prompt validations (see smoke commands)
- monitor: watch 5xx, latency p95, token-cost anomaly
- rollback: flip feature flag + terraform revert if criteria met
```

maya: smoke commands (run from staging jumper):

maya: ```
# quick smoke
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.api.redwood-inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-small","prompt":"Summarize: The deployment is healthy"}' | jq .
# latency check (10 samples)
for i in {1..10}; do time curl -s https://staging.api.redwood-inference/health; done
```

raj: quick ping @liam — left an infra CR comment re: IAM role scoping, small nit.

liam: saw it, thanks — I'll update the module before the window.

sophia: rollback script (local):

sophia: ```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
# 1) disable canary flag
redwood feature-flags set tidalwave_canary false
# 2) revert terraform
cd infra/tidalwave
terraform apply -auto-approve -var='target=previous'
# 3) notify
curl -X POST https://hooks.slack.com/services/XXX -d '{"text":"TidalWave rollback complete"}'
```

archie: note: onprem agent needs 2m drain time, add 5m buffer before network cutover.

deploy-bot: Calendar: TidalWave private window reserved Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Invite sent to maya, liam, sophia, archie, raj.

maya: final runbook: canary at 10% for 10m; if any of: 5xx rate > 0.5%, p95 latency > 1.2s, or error regression on smoke prompts -> rollback immediately. Else ramp to 50% -> 100% with 10m observation at each stage.

liam: I'll post smoke results in this thread at T+12m and T+25m during canary.

sophia: I'll be on-call for rollback from T-30m to T+60m.

archie: I have the customer's IP list; uploading to the ticket now. Will run ACL test t-40m.

maya: Thanks folks — will do a final roll call at 01:30 UTC. :white_check_mark:
